summary: Persistent Google-authenticated profiles resolved exclusively by verified issuer and subject, backed by server-owned admission policy and request-time execution and quota limits.

origin.authority: Snapshot only; referenced live source and tests are authoritative and may have changed after this record.

evidence.note: Defines provider-neutral external identity structure carrying verified issuer, subject, method, scopes, roles, and display attributes.
Resolves exactly one active local Aegis profile matched by verified issuer and subject identity index.
Server-owned admission boundary enforcing closed-by-default profile creation and provisioning unprivileged pending profiles when self-service is enabled.
Exposes /api/v1/auth/profile/admit and /api/v1/auth/profile/me endpoints that accept only Spring-verified JWT principals.
Enforces request-time rate, execution, and concurrency reservations with global/profile limit switches and audited JSON-RPC limit denials.
Verifies closed admission mode and unprivileged pending profile self-service creation.
Verifies rate limit enforcement, stable PROFILE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED error formatting, and global limits toggle.
Defines product requirements for spoof-resistant identity binding, closed admission policy, limit hierarchy, and audit constraints.
